description: Implementation of the SharedRegionParcelable class for handling shared memory regions in Android AAudio, including methods for setup, validation, resolution, and dumping of shared memory region info.

classes.name: SharedRegionParcelable
classes.description: Parcelable wrapper for SharedRegion data, providing methods to setup, validate, resolve shared memory, and dump info.

methods.name: SharedRegionParcelable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes from a SharedRegion object.

methods.name: parcelable
methods.description: Returns a SharedRegion object with current parcelable data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes internal fields from a MemoryInfoTuple.

methods.name: getMemoryInfo
methods.description: Returns memory info tuple, optionally remapping shared memory index.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the shared memory region address using provided memory parcels.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shared memory region parameters.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Logs the current state of the shared memory region.
